text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Bills of Exchange (Cheque Truncation) Regulations.

3. For the purposes of section 87A of the Act and regulation 4, the electronic payment information of any cheque or instrument shall comprise the following:
(a)the unique identification number which is assigned to the cheque or the instrument for the purposes of presentment by electronic means;
(b)the code which identifies the banker on whom the cheque or the instrument is drawn; and
(c)the amount of the cheque or the instrument as entered by the drawer of the cheque or the instrument.
